Well-known in Condé-sur-l'Escaut for the high quality of my services and affordable prices, I have been running this garage for many years. Unlike large chains, where management cannot know every employee, I personally inspect every car before offering it for sale, and each vehicle comes with a two-year warranty. For repairs, all the necessary equipment and most spare parts are already available. You can also count on me for a top-notch car wash or a fluid top-up. Steve's Garage is here for you!

Do the cars come with a warranty?
All our vehicles come with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase.
Which payment methods do you accept?
We accept cash and card payments.
Cheques are not accepted due to problems we have experienced in the past.
How can we be notified of unexpected changes to opening hours?
In the event of a problem, an announcement will be posted on our Facebook page.
Support for deaf and hard-of-hearing visitors

I am fluent in French Sign Language (LSF), as my daughter has been hard of hearing since birth. You can therefore visit the garage without any worries and without an interpreter. Everyone is welcome, and we will be able to communicate easily!

Quotes are automatically sent by email whenever you book an appointment on our website. They are also printed and handed to you in person before any repair or vehicle purchase. If you lose yours, simply check your emails!
At Steve's Garage, quality and trust are the cornerstones of my values. I commit to:
Never charging any additional fees without prior approval.
Using high-quality replacement parts that come with a warranty.
Meeting the deadlines agreed upon when you drop off your vehicle.
Recycling used oil and defective parts in an environmentally friendly way, whenever possible.

This website uses as few cookies as possible. The only cookies we use are essential to the proper functioning of the site, particularly the online appointment booking system. There are no ads, and therefore no advertising tracking: you're here for your car, not to be tracked!

Our quotes are free and valid for 30 days from the date they are issued. All repairs require the quote to be signed in advance. A deposit may be requested when ordering specific parts. Vehicles not collected within 15 days of the work being completed may incur storage fees.

The information you provide is used solely to manage your appointments, send your quotes and handle billing. It remains strictly between you and Steve's Garage and will never be resold or shared with third parties.

The garage has been fitted out to welcome everyone in the best possible conditions. The entrance, reception area and office are all on one level, making them fully accessible to people with reduced mobility and wheelchair users. Also, as mentioned in the help section, I am fluent in French Sign Language, so visitors who are hard of hearing are, of course, very welcome.
Come and get help with complete peace of mind. An expert since 2009, I let my Google Maps reviews speak for themselves. Every beauty gets special care here – and yes, I am talking about cars.
